subject: SIG follow-up: request for RBAC/SCIM exports and MFA enforcement evidence
messages:
From: Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@acme-payments.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-payments.com
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: RBAC / SCIM / MFA evidence

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team is completing the SIG questionnaire and has a handful of follow-ups specific to access controls before we can accept Redwood for production:

- A machine-readable export showing current RBAC role definitions and which internal roles have the ability to create/assign roles (we need a CSV or PDF).
- Evidence of SCIM provisioning: provisioning logs for recent user creates/updates for our test tenant (last 30 days).
- MFA enforcement snapshot: proof that account-level MFA is enforced for console/API access and a snapshot of enforcement date.
- SAML metadata and confirmation of IdP-initiated SSO support.

Can you confirm what you can share and expected ETA? We can accept redacted user identifiers if needed, but we need the mapping and timestamps for audit.

Best,
Tom
Tom Jensen
Security Manager, Acme Payments
[Attachment: acme_SIG_questions_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: RBAC / SCIM / MFA evidence

Hi Tom —

Appreciate the clear list. We can provide all of the items you requested. Proposed plan:

1) RBAC export: we will produce a role mapping PDF and a CSV that includes role name, description, permissions scope, and the admin flag (who can assign roles).
2) SCIM provisioning logs: Dev will pull a CSV of provisioning events for your tenant (creates/updates/deprovisions) with timestamps. We will redact PII per your preference.
3) MFA enforcement snapshot: we will provide a policy extract plus an enforcement snapshot (log) showing enforcement date and affected accounts.
4) SAML metadata: we will attach current SP metadata and note support for IdP-initiated flows.

If redaction is required, please confirm whether you want full email addresses removed or replaced with hashed identifiers.

ETA: we can deliver a secure Drive folder with the files and a short explanation doc by EOD Monday (Aug 23). If you need anything sooner, let us know and we can prioritize.

I'll loop in Dev to pull the SCIM export and Marissa for any contractual sign-off for sharing tenant-scoped logs.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
[Phone: +1 415-555-0172]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: RBAC / SCIM / MFA evidence

Tom — quick note on data sharing:

We have the standard tenant-scoped evidence sharing process in place. For provisioning logs and enforcement snapshots that contain tenant identifiers, we will only share if Acme signs the mutual NDA/evidence access addendum. If you can confirm that your security mailbox (security@acme-payments.com) has sign-off authority, we can expedite.

Otherwise, happy to provide redacted outputs immediately.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: evidence_sharing_addendum_draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@acme-payments.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 01:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: RBAC / SCIM / MFA evidence

Hi all —

I've pulled the exports for Acme's test tenant and put them in a restricted Drive folder pending Marissa's confirmation. Attachments (stubs below):

- redwood_rbac_role-mapping_20270821.pdf (application/pdf, 124KB) — contains role names, permission sets, and the "can_assign_roles" boolean per role.
- scim_provisioning_export_20270821.csv (text/csv, 46KB) — columns: event_id, timestamp, action, target_type, target_id (hashed), performed_by (internal_service), tenant_id (redacted).
- mfa_policy_enforcement_snapshot_20270821.log (text/plain, 18KB) — shows enforcement policy id, effective_date, scope.

Note: user identifiers have been hashed using SHA1 truncated to 8 chars as discussed. If Acme requires original email addresses for matching, we will need an executed evidence access addendum.

Soojin — I also exported the SAML SP metadata and included it at the Drive link (metadata.xml).

Let me know if you want these converted to a different format.

Thanks,
Dev
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: (drive folder shared) redwood_acme_evidence_20270821/]

From: Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@acme-payments.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 04:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: RBAC / SCIM / MFA evidence

Thanks 11for the quick turnaround. We9d prefer the redacted exports first. The evidence access addendum looks fine but I need it countersigned by our legal team; ETA for that is Tuesday.

Couple of follow-ups:
- For the RBAC export, can you include a column that indicates whether the role is allowed to impersonate service accounts? That's on our SIG checklist.
- For the SCIM events, can you include the SCIM path (e.g., /Users) and the raw HTTP response status when available? Even a truncated column is fine.

If you can add those fields to the CSV before sharing, that would help our mapping.

Tom

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@acme-payments.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>

Acknowledged 42on the extra fields. Dev 42will add impersonation and SCIM path + response_code columns and re-upload to the folder. Marissa 42will start the addendum sign-off workflow.

We will push the updated CSV and the metadata.xml to the Drive link and notify you once the folder is available with read-only access.
